data.long_meaning: From the Old High German word ‘ric’ meaning ‘power, rule, ruler’. In Old Norse, it was used as a title for chieftains or kings. In Christian contexts, Rik can be seen as a symbol of divine rule and protection. The name Rik carries the meaning “Power, rule, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rik usually hope their child will grow to embody power, rule, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
